edit.hint: Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel

empty.hidden_only: The first {count} entries here are all hidden: show hidden files to see them.
empty.skipped: Some entries here couldn't be read or shown: they are left out.
empty.rows: The tree shows at most {count} rows: collapse some folders to see the rest.

search.no_rg: Searching contents on another machine needs ripgrep (rg) there.
search.too_long: That query is too long to search for.
search.unfiltered: No git or ripgrep on {machine}: ignored files are included.
search.skipped: Some files or folders couldn't be read: results may be incomplete.

git.failed: Couldn't read Git status: Git marks are not shown.
git.untrusted: Untrusted folder: trust it in the Git sidebar to show Git marks.
git.truncated: Too many changes: not every changed file has a Git mark.

error.gone: {name} no longer exists: the list was refreshed
error.name: That name can't be used
error.reveal: Can't show it in the file manager
